workflows.name: Order Confirmation + Ops Alert
workflows.description: Fires after Yoco confirms payment. Sends WhatsApp confirmation to customer and ops team alert.
steps: Receive Yoco webhook payload
Fetch order from Supabase (order_id from metadata)
Send WhatsApp template 'order_confirmation' to customer
Send ops alert to +27737815979 with order summary
Update order status to 'confirmed' in Supabase
Create packing slip entry in Supabase

workflows.name: WhatsApp Inbound Order Flow
workflows.description: Receives inbound WhatsApp messages from customers. Detects order intent, shows product menu, builds draft order, sends Yoco payment link.
steps: Receive inbound message from Vula WhatsApp webhook
Detect intent: greeting / order / track / help
If greeting: send welcome + product category list (interactive list)
If category selected: send products in that category (interactive list)
If product selected: add to draft order in Supabase (whatsapp_draft_orders)
Ask 'Want to add anything else? Or reply DONE to checkout'
If DONE: ask for delivery address
Create cart + order in Vula API
Send Yoco checkout link via WhatsApp
Confirm order placed once Yoco webhook fires

workflows.name: Abandoned Cart Recovery
workflows.description: Finds carts older than 1hr with status 'active' and no order. Sends WhatsApp recovery message with 10% discount.
steps: Query Supabase: commerce_carts WHERE status='active' AND updated_at < now()-1hr
For each cart: check no commerce_order exists for that cart_id
Generate 10% discount code (insert into discounts table)
Send WhatsApp text: 'Hey [name], you left [items] in your cart. Here's 10% off: [code]'
Mark cart as 'recovery_sent' in metadata
If no response after 24hr: mark cart 'abandoned'

workflows.name: Order Dispatch Notification
workflows.description: Ops team triggers this when driver picks up. Sends dispatch WhatsApp to customer with ETA.
steps: Receive order_id + eta from ops trigger
Fetch customer phone from Supabase
Send WhatsApp template 'order_dispatched' with ETA
Update order status to 'dispatched'
Schedule delivery confirmation check in 3hrs

workflows.name: Weekly Specials Broadcast
workflows.description: Sends weekly catch specials to opted-in customers. Drives repeat orders.
steps: Fetch this week's is_daily_catch=TRUE products from Supabase
Build specials text (product name + price + catch source)
Fetch opted-in customer phones from Supabase (whatsapp_conversations WHERE status='active')
Send WhatsApp template 'weekly_specials' to each customer (batch, max 1000/day free tier)
Log broadcast stats to Supabase

workflows.name: Reorder Reminder (7 days)
workflows.description: Finds customers whose last order was exactly 7 days ago. Sends personalised reorder prompt.
steps: Query Supabase: commerce_orders WHERE created_at BETWEEN now()-8d AND now()-7d AND status='delivered'
For each order: get customer_phone + most recent product name
Send WhatsApp template 'reorder_reminder'
Log to whatsapp_conversations

workflows.name: Fisherman Supplier Intake
workflows.description: When a new supplier messages, captures their details and sends an intake form link.
steps: Detect supplier intent (keywords: 'supply', 'sell', 'catch', 'supplier', 'verskaf')
Reply: 'Thanks for reaching out! We'd love to hear more. Please complete our supplier form: [link]'
Insert lead into Supabase (supplier_leads table)
Alert ops team on WhatsApp

workflows.name: Review Solicitation
workflows.trigger: Schedule: daily 14:00 SAST (check deliveries from prior day)
workflows.description: Sends HelloPeter + Google review links 24hrs after delivery confirmation.
steps: Query Supabase: commerce_orders WHERE status='delivered' AND updated_at BETWEEN now()-25h AND now()-23h
For each order: send WhatsApp text with HelloPeter + Google review links
Mark review_requested=TRUE on order
Log send to Supabase

workflows.name: Stock Alert
workflows.description: Checks product stock levels. Alerts ops when any product drops below threshold.
steps: Query Supabase: commerce_products WHERE tenant_id='off-the-hook' AND stock_quantity < 5 AND in_stock=TRUE
For each low-stock product: send WhatsApp alert to ops (+27737815979)
If stock_quantity = 0: auto-set in_stock=FALSE

workflows.name: Cold Chain Alert
workflows.description: Temperature sensor webhook. Fires if cold chain is breached. Alerts ops and logs incident.
steps: Receive temperature payload from sensor
IF temperature > 8°C: send urgent WhatsApp to ops
Log incident to Supabase (cold_chain_incidents table)
If sustained breach (>30min): notify delivery team to cancel affected orders
